- Added a "Start on APIDot" section in SKILL.md to clarify key APIDot entry points from ClawHub.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or API changes; documentation only.

Initial release of apidot-seedance-1-0-pro-api.

- Provides detailed documentation and workflow guidance for integrating APIDot's Seedance 1.0 Pro API, focused on text-to-video, image-to-video, and short video generation.
- Includes model routing, async task submission, polling, and webhook integration advice.
- Contains strict security and API key handling instructions.
- Offers model-specific integration tips and official resource links.
- Does not contain any executable code, network requests, or stored credentials—documentation only.
